subagentStart.bash: command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .claude/scripts/activity_log.ps1 -Event start || true

subagentStop.bash: command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .claude/scripts/activity_log.ps1 -Event stop || true
